title: Draft the Table II domain randomization declaration for Step 7
summary: locomotion/randomization.py declares table2_v1 for issue #67: one field per Liu et al. Table II row with its status (kept or adapted), the project range for the 7.466 kg direct-drive robot and the explicit motor law, the draw granularity and the reason, plus a force-based training push schedule. declaration() gives canonical JSON and a SHA-256 that run identities will bind; none declares the nominal properties. The Step 7 section of docs/TRAINING.md explains each row and the motor-cap effect. Unit tests check the hash, draw bounds against the named joint limits, generator determinism and isolation, the payload parallel-axis helper and the capped strength ceiling. No environment applies the draws yet, and nothing is trained.
next: Apply the declaration in the CPU surrogate with --randomization none|table2_v1, fill the privileged friction and push telemetry, and bring the none against table2_v1 surrogate comparison to the first #67 review, which freezes the ranges and push schedule.
reason: A declaration and its CPU tests establish no native result, admission or accepted capability.
